content.stem: 欧盟反洗钱指令的关键目标是什么？

options.A: 加强对欧盟国家支付活动的管控以减少洗钱活动.
options.B: 在欧盟范围内建立一个由金融机构共同协作以防范洗钱活动的网络.
options.C: 在整个欧盟建立一致的监管环境以防止洗钱.
options.D: 允许各成员国在欧盟金融情报机构的协助下讨论该立法草案.

content.stem_en: Which is a key goal of the EU's Directives on money laundering?

options_en.A: Address control of payments in EU countries to reduce money laundering.
options_en.B: Build a network of financial institutions that work together to prevent money laundering across the EU.
options_en.C: Establish a consistent regulatory environment across the EU to prevent money laundering.
options_en.D: Allow member states to discuss the draft legislation with the cooperation of the EU financial intelligence units.
